title: Synchronized Multi-Screen Interactive Demo
summary: A touch table, a 4K wall and a handheld controller telling one story in perfect sync for a global cloud provider.
problem: Three machines and an Android input device had to stay in lockstep — video loops drifted, transitions raced and some media fell back to slow software decoding.
solution: React/TypeScript apps where the touch table owns the authoritative state and the 4K screen mirrors it; coordinated video loops, cancellable transitions and interactive charts; re-encoded media into hardware-friendly formats; Windows kiosk delivery.
result: Designed a 12-hour Playwright endurance run — 107 cycles, 2,461 automated actions — that surfaced race conditions and decoding bottlenecks and shaped the playback fixes.
highlights: Fixed controller-to-chart input by replaying pointer events in the right order
Diagnosed 4:4:4 video forcing software decoding; switched to 4:2:0
Split a 42 MB audio track out of a 363 MB video
